title: Joplin Notes Sync Settings
description: Non-secret connection settings. Set your Joplin API token from the plugin's own page (Menu → Joplin Notes Sync) — it is stored as a local secret, never here.

joplinUrl.title: Joplin Web Clipper URL
joplinUrl.description: Base URL of Joplin's local Web Clipper API. Enable it in Joplin under Options → Web Clipper.

parentNotebookTitle.title: Parent notebook
parentNotebookTitle.description: Notebook created in Joplin to hold one sub-notebook per Super Productivity project.

syncIntervalSec.title: Auto-sync interval (seconds)
syncIntervalSec.description: How often to check for changed notes and push them to Joplin. Set to 0 to disable automatic sync (manual button only). Values under 15 are treated as 15.

syncTaskNotes.title: Sync task notes
syncTaskNotes.description: Also push each task's own Notes field (opened from the task itself) into a "Tasks" sub-notebook under the project. One-way (Super Productivity → Joplin), same as the project's Notes tab, which is always synced.
